title: SEND PLAY DATA LEADS WITH COPY, THE TEXT IS FOLDED AWAY
why: Job 113, critic score 2 on the play data page: a raw debug dump filled the screen. The export text is now folded behind a show data button (closed by default), a muted line says how many runs and notes are in it, copy to clipboard is the one hero, and the page packs to the top. The text, the copy, clear recorder and the restore box are unchanged. The superhot pane also gets its value as the 56px hero and its key line as a chip.
now: Send play data opens on one big copy button and a short line of what is in it; show data opens the full text.
